texts: The lanterns at the Hollows stand along the forest paths.
The lanterns at the Hollows burn dimly.

fields.sentence: The lanterns at the Hollows stand along the forest paths.

review.notes: Bare position clause with a postural verb correctly mints no event; "at" -> LocatedIn and "along" -> the entity-attached surface preposition head are both as specified. "the Hollows" takes the capitalized-plural Name-only treatment (Name atom, no GroupOf, no invented kind), and forest_path fuses with genus only (noun modifier not exposed).

fields.sentence: The lanterns at the Hollows burn dimly.

q1_issues.issue: Intransitive 'burn' takes an Agent on the lantern group, but the instruction set's intransitive-subject test routes a non-volitional undergoer / internal-change-of-state subject to Patient (and 'burn' is on its own change-the-object list), so Agent asserts a volitional doer the clause does not support.
The per-member distribution rule repeats the same Agent role for each member's burning event, so the role error propagates into the rule's conclusion.

review.notes: 'the Hollows' correctly takes the capitalized-plural-label Name-only treatment (Name atom, no GroupOf, no invented kind), 'at' correctly routes to LocatedIn as containment, and the definite plural correctly gets both the group event and the per-member rule at (STV 1.0 0.9).

issues.reason: Thematic roles bars Agent for an intransitive subject that undergoes the eventuality and restricts it to a self-powered mover (an animate, or a vessel/vehicle moving under its own power), so (Agent sk_burn_1 sk_group_1) asserts a volitional doer for a burning lantern that the clause does not state.
The per-member rule's conclusion repeats the same unlicensed (Agent (sk_burn $x) $x), propagating the false volitional-doer claim to every derived member event.

adjudication.defect_summary: Both emissions should carry the change-of-state/non-volitional-undergoer role instead: (Patient sk_burn_1 sk_group_1) in the group event and (Patient (sk_burn $x) $x) in the rule's conclusion, everything else standing as written.
adjudication.notes: 'the Hollows' as a Name-only individual with no invented kind, 'at' routed to LocatedIn as containment, and the definite plural's group event plus per-member rule at (STV 1.0 0.9) are all correct. Only the role choice fails.
